candidates.title: Draft restaurant order status messages

demandEvidence.chore: Connect restaurant order systems with customer notifications and delivery updates, including order confirmations, delivery assignments, and failed notifications.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I want to understand how n8n can help connect restaurant order systems, customer notifications, and delivery updates.

experimentPlan.output: A review queue of concise draft messages for fictional order confirmations, delivery assignments, status updates, and notification failures.
inputs: Fictional order ID and restaurant label
Fictional order status and delivery assignment
experimentPlan.trigger: An operator submits one fictional order event to a manually started test run.
steps: Accept a fictional order event in a fixed sample format.
Check that its status and delivery assignment use allowed sample values.
Select a proposed message template for that event type.
Draft a short customer update using only supplied fields.
Flag missing fields or a failure state for human review.
Show the draft and event side by side for approval.
experimentPlan.acceptanceCheck: For a fixed set of fictional events, verify each draft repeats the supplied order status and assignment accurately, flags missing values, and never sends a message.
experimentPlan.humanBoundary: An operator supplies fictional test records and approved wording, checks every draft and failure flag, and authorizes any later live integration or message sending.
unverified: No supplied implementation reference documents webhook receipt, restaurant system access, messaging integrations, retry behavior, or delivery.
The post does not establish field schemas, event frequency, commercial demand, or whether automated wording is acceptable.

ease.reason: A beginner can mock one status-to-message path with synthetic rows, but no supplied reference supports webhooks or messaging integrations.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: restaurant operators may pay to reduce manual order updates; this request proves neither purchase intent nor payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week test can draft confirmation and status messages from sample events; integrations, delivery and failure handling remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed event-to-draft loop is repeatable, but no implementation capability is documented and a person must verify and approve messages.

evidence.reason: The retained post span asks about order data, restaurant notifications, customer updates and failures, but supplies no field details or corroboration.

candidates.reason: The retained post span states a concrete order-notification workflow, so I scoped a synthetic draft-only experiment. No matching implementation reference is supplied; the honest mean is below the threshold.
